entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand is not supported; 'and'/'unless' support mixing them
entries.rationale: lowerVectorSetOp is reached only after mixedExpHistogramSetOp has had the opportunity to route a pure float/histogram `or` through lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp; that recognizer also sees histogram-forwarding and/unless chains. Each operand is then lowered through lowerVectorSetOpOperand and validated to have a live float, histogram, or mixed sample kind. A remaining pure-kind mismatch therefore means an internal recognizer/dispatcher contract has drifted, not a PromQL rejection exposed at the wire.

guard: past returning if err := requireVectorSetOpSampleKind("left", leftKind); err != nil
past returning if err := requireVectorSetOpSampleKind("right", rightKind); err != nil

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators")
